{% comment %}
  Filters collection grids so cross-tagged products do not leak between
  top-level category branches when smart-collection rules overlap.

  Accepts:
  - product: Product object
  - collection: Current collection object (optional)
  - collection_handle: Current collection handle
{% endcomment %}

{%- liquid
  assign product_visible = true
  assign current_collection = collection
  assign current_collection_handle = collection_handle | default: current_collection.handle | default: '' | strip
  assign current_handle_token = ',' | append: current_collection_handle | append: ','
  assign expected_category1 = current_collection.metafields.custom.category1 | default: '' | strip
  assign product_category1 = product.metafields.custom.category1 | default: '' | strip
  assign expected_category1_key = ''
  assign product_category1_key = ''
  assign has_mommy_and_me_tag = false
  assign has_family_matching_tag = false
  assign has_daddy_and_me_tag = false
  assign has_couples_tag = false
  assign has_maternity_tag = false
  assign mommy_branch_handles = ',mommy-and-me,new-matching-outfits,popular-mommy-me-1,pajamas,dresses,mother-daughter-matching-dresses,swimsuits,tops,sweaters,bottoms,leggings,pants,formal-dresses,maxi-dresses,midi-dresses,mini-dresses,sundresses,jumpsuits,rompers,skirts,mommy-and-me-easter-dresses,easter-matching-outfits,spring-matching-outfits,'
  assign family_branch_handles = ',matching-outfits,family-matching-outfits,new-women-outfits,popular-family-matching,family-pajamas,family-swimsuits,family-sets,matching-family-vacation-outfits,matching-hawaiian-outfits,family-tops,family-sweaters,'
  assign daddy_branch_handles = ',daddy-and-me,daddy-me,daddy-me-t-shirts,daddy-me-shirts,trunks,'
  assign couples_branch_handles = ',couples,couple-matching,matching-couples-t-shirts,'
  assign maternity_branch_handles = ',maternity,'

  for tag in product.tags
    assign normalized_tag = tag | strip
    assign normalized_tag_downcase = normalized_tag | downcase

    if normalized_tag_downcase == 'mommy and me'
      assign has_mommy_and_me_tag = true
    elsif normalized_tag_downcase == 'family matching'
      assign has_family_matching_tag = true
    elsif normalized_tag_downcase == 'daddy and me'
      assign has_daddy_and_me_tag = true
    elsif normalized_tag_downcase == 'couples'
      assign has_couples_tag = true
    elsif normalized_tag_downcase == 'maternity'
      assign has_maternity_tag = true
    endif

    if product_category1 == blank
      if normalized_tag_downcase contains 'category1:' or normalized_tag_downcase contains 'category:'
        assign product_category1 = normalized_tag | split: ':' | last | strip
      endif
    endif
  endfor

  if current_collection_handle == 'mother-daughter-matching-dresses'
    assign expected_category1 = 'Mommy and Me'
  elsif expected_category1 == blank
    if mommy_branch_handles contains current_handle_token
      assign expected_category1 = 'Mommy and Me'
    elsif family_branch_handles contains current_handle_token
      assign expected_category1 = 'Family Matching'
    elsif daddy_branch_handles contains current_handle_token
      assign expected_category1 = 'Daddy and Me'
    elsif couples_branch_handles contains current_handle_token
      assign expected_category1 = 'Couples'
    elsif maternity_branch_handles contains current_handle_token
      assign expected_category1 = 'Maternity'
    endif
  endif

  assign normalized_expected_category1 = expected_category1 | downcase | strip
  assign normalized_product_category1 = product_category1 | downcase | strip

  if normalized_expected_category1 contains 'mommy' or normalized_expected_category1 contains 'mother'
    assign expected_category1_key = 'mommy'
  elsif normalized_expected_category1 contains 'family' or normalized_expected_category1 contains 'famil'
    assign expected_category1_key = 'family'
  elsif normalized_expected_category1 contains 'daddy' or normalized_expected_category1 contains 'father'
    assign expected_category1_key = 'daddy'
  elsif normalized_expected_category1 contains 'couple'
    assign expected_category1_key = 'couples'
  elsif normalized_expected_category1 contains 'maternity'
    assign expected_category1_key = 'maternity'
  endif

  if normalized_product_category1 contains 'mommy' or normalized_product_category1 contains 'mami' or normalized_product_category1 contains 'mother' or normalized_product_category1 contains 'daughter'
    assign product_category1_key = 'mommy'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'mam'
    assign product_category1_key = 'mommy'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'family'
    assign product_category1_key = 'family'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'famil'
    assign product_category1_key = 'family'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'rodzin'
    assign product_category1_key = 'family'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'daddy'
    assign product_category1_key = 'daddy'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'pap'
    assign product_category1_key = 'daddy'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'father'
    assign product_category1_key = 'daddy'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'tata'
    assign product_category1_key = 'daddy'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'couple'
    assign product_category1_key = 'couples'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'pareja'
    assign product_category1_key = 'couples'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'coppia'
    assign product_category1_key = 'couples'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'cuplu'
    assign product_category1_key = 'couples'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'casal'
    assign product_category1_key = 'couples'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'maternity'
    assign product_category1_key = 'maternity'
  endif
  if product_category1_key == blank and normalized_product_category1 contains 'matern'
    assign product_category1_key = 'maternity'
  endif

  assign normalized_product_title = product.title | default: '' | downcase
  assign normalized_product_handle = product.handle | default: '' | downcase

  case expected_category1_key
    when 'mommy'
      if product_category1_key != blank
        if product_category1_key != expected_category1_key and has_mommy_and_me_tag == false
          assign product_visible = false
        endif
      elsif has_mommy_and_me_tag == false
        assign product_visible = false
      endif
      if has_family_matching_tag
        if normalized_product_title contains 'family matching' or normalized_product_handle contains 'family-matching'
          assign product_visible = false
        endif
      endif
    when 'family'
      if product_category1_key != blank
        if product_category1_key != expected_category1_key and has_family_matching_tag == false
          assign product_visible = false
        endif
      elsif has_family_matching_tag == false
        assign product_visible = false
      endif
    when 'daddy'
      if product_category1_key != blank
        if product_category1_key != expected_category1_key and has_daddy_and_me_tag == false
          assign product_visible = false
        endif
      elsif has_daddy_and_me_tag == false
        assign product_visible = false
      endif
    when 'couples'
      if product_category1_key != blank
        if product_category1_key != expected_category1_key and has_couples_tag == false
          assign product_visible = false
        endif
      elsif has_couples_tag == false
        assign product_visible = false
      endif
    when 'maternity'
      if product_category1_key != blank
        if product_category1_key != expected_category1_key and has_maternity_tag == false
          assign product_visible = false
        endif
      elsif has_maternity_tag == false
        assign product_visible = false
      endif
  endcase

  echo product_visible
-%}
